name: Kitt
summary: Find and verify work emails in real time, with a credit balance and job lookup.

api_key.description: a Kitt API key (API section of your Kitt dashboard)

notes: Real-time mode (realtime true) answers in the response; it is throttled by your concurrent request limit and over it answers with an error to retry.
HTTP 402 means a rate limit or insufficient funds; the body says which. 401 means a missing or wrong key.
With realtime false, a job is queued and its result is fetched with trykitt.job.get.

endpoints.name: Test the API key
endpoints.summary: 200 means the key passed authentication, 401 a problem with the header or key.

endpoints.name: Find a work email
endpoints.summary: Finds a person's work email from a name and a company domain or website.

fullName.description: The full name as listed on LinkedIn or another directory; do not clean it up.

domain.description: The company's email domain or website; a website is reduced to its domain.

linkedinStandardProfileURL.description: The person's LinkedIn profile URL; helps when the full name is hidden.

realtime.description: true to get the result in the response.

customData.description: Your own id, returned with the result.

strictNameMatches.description: Example in the docs sets false; controls how strictly names must match.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a lookup job that only produces data and uses credits. Email domains give better results than websites, and websites better than company names.

endpoints.name: Verify an email
endpoints.summary: Checks whether an email address is deliverable.

realtime.description: true to get the result in the response.

customData.description: Your own id, returned with the result.

treatAliasesAsValid.description: Example in the docs sets true; whether alias addresses count as valid.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a verification job that only produces data and uses credits.

endpoints.name: Get a job's result
endpoints.summary: Fetches the result of a queued job by id.
